movie.title: The Fix
movie.overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives head to Tehran after the end of the Afghanistan war to pull off a life-changing heist.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced and war-torn ex-CIA operatives find themselves adrift without a mission. Seeking redemption and financial freedom, they pull together for a dangerous, high-stakes operation in the heart of Tehran. Driven by trauma, betrayal, and a desire to control their own fates, the team sets out to execute a life-changing score. However, infiltrating enemy territory tests their loyalties and forces them to confront the true cost of their past choices.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Following the turbulent end of the war in Afghanistan, a band of former CIA operatives finds themselves cast aside, disgraced, and deeply scarred by their years of covert service. Struggling to adapt to civilian life while carrying the psychological weight of their past operations, they come together around an audacious proposal: execute a massive, covert heist in Tehran. The target promises a life-changing payout that could secure their futures and provide an escape from their pasts. However, operating off-grid in one of the most hostile espionage environments in the world requires precision, trust, and absolute discretion. As they assemble their team and map out the infiltration, long-buried grievances and unresolved trauma begin to surface, threatening their unity. Once on the ground in Tehran, unforeseen complications quickly derail their plan, escalating the operation into a deadly game of survival. Hunted by local intelligence and confronted with secrets within their own ranks, the operatives must rely on their lethal training to navigate the crossfire. Ultimately, the high-stakes mission forces each member to choose between personal survival and the remaining bonds of brotherhood.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Fix is an edge-of-your-seat thriller that explores the psychological aftermath of modern conflict through the lens of a high-octane heist story. Set against the backdrop of post-war uncertainty following the end of the Afghanistan conflict, the narrative follows a hardened crew of ex-CIA operatives left abandoned by the system they served. Desperate to reclaim agency over their lives, they orchestrate an ambitious, unsanctioned operation in Tehran to pull off a massive score. Combining realistic tactical action with compelling character drama, the story delves into themes of loyalty, betrayal, and the deep emotional scars carried by veterans of shadow wars as they risk everything on one final, desperate play.

story_structure.climax: The mission reaches its peak operational tension when their carefully crafted plan unravels in Tehran, forcing the team into an intense confrontation where survival and success hang in the balance.
story_structure.conflict: Driven by desperation and the desire for a life-changing score, the team decides to unite for an off-the-books heist targeting a high-stakes objective deep inside Tehran.
story_structure.resolution: The surviving operatives process the immediate fallout of the operation, facing the ultimate cost of their ambition and the reality of their new lives outside the covert world.
story_structure.introduction: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives struggle to find direction after leaving active duty.
story_structure.risingAction: As they infiltrate hostile territory, the operative group must navigate strict surveillance, high-stakes logistics, and deep-seated personal trauma that threatens to fracture their trust from within.
